hero_description: An overseas community service project organized by medical students from the Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, National University of Singapore.
who_we_are_text: Project Battambang is an overseas community service project organized by students from the Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, National University of Singapore. Since 2012, our team has been dedicated to improving healthcare access, providing health education, and supporting education initiatives for underserved communities in Battambang and Poipet, Cambodia.

initiatives.title: Health Screening
initiatives.description: Providing mass village health clinics, door-to-door screenings, chronic disease monitoring, and hospital referrals.

initiatives.title: Education Development
initiatives.description: Investing in youth through the Light-A-Dream Scholarship, School Support Programme, and community hygiene education.

initiatives.title: Post-Trip Reports
initiatives.description: Transparently documenting our annual trip findings, clinical statistics, financial statements, and community impact.
